title: Which Day of Your Madeira Holiday Is Best for a Boat Trip?
description: Usually your second or third day: rested after the flight, with spare days left if the sea says no. Avoid travel days, and never save the boat for the last.
heroAlt: A coffee cup and a folded map on a balcony table above a calm Funchal bay in early morning
keywords: best day of holiday for a boat trip madeira
when in my trip should i book a boat trip
boat trip early or late in holiday
madeira one week itinerary with boat trip
plan madeira holiday around the sea

images.prompt: Early morning on a hotel balcony in Funchal's Lido area, looking south-west over the sea. In the foreground, slightly out of focus, a small round table with a cup of coffee, a folded paper map of Madeira and a pair of sunglasses. Beyond the railing, the calm sea in soft golden light, and far out a small white motor boat with a dark canopy heading west along the coast towards Câmara de Lobos. No people, no readable text, true colours.
